challenge.better_approach: Considered having the tester's installer install the commons hook too: that reaches across components (RULE 1). Considered copying the pre-commit body into the new hook: two doors that can drift; exec of the installed pre-commit keeps one.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That every commons box installs hooks with cairn artifact install-hook, so the new hook reaches a box only when that is re-run there; that is named in the READY. And that git merge refuses over a staged index (measured 2026-11-16 for A1, rc 2).
challenge.prior_art: cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-merge-commit (db250e9bf3f9, built, awaiting its walk) is the same mechanism for the cairn repo, from git's own pre-merge-commit.sample; this copies the pattern into this tool's hooks, citing it.
challenge.real_collision: A distinction with check_shared_index, which exempts a merge by MERGE_HEAD that pre-merge-commit cannot see yet; the hook supplies the fact git has not written and the guard is unchanged.

answers.falsifier: In a scratch record repo with the artifact hooks installed, a non-conflicting merge of a branch the door refuses leaves HEAD unmoved; red on origin/main, where it commits. Horizon: the next commons land prints the artifact check line.
answers.how: Add cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/pre-merge-commit, carrying the 'artifact check' marker _install_hook already reads. It unsets GIT_INDEX_FILE and execs the installed pre-commit (git rev-parse --git-path hooks/pre-commit), the same shape as cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-merge-commit: during pre-merge-commit MERGE_HEAD is not yet written, so check_shared_index (cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py) would read GIT_INDEX_FILE as a shared-index commit and refuse every land; git merge refuses to start over a staged index, so the index holds only the merge. In cairn/tools/artifact/__main__.py, install-hook also installs pre-merge-commit beside pre-commit, refusing one that exists and is not this tool's, as pre-commit already does. The proof cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_a_commons_merge_runs_the_artifact_door.py builds a scratch record repo, installs the hooks through the real install path with CAIRN_REPO naming a scratch door that refuses a staged path containing 'hand-edit' and records the GIT_INDEX_FILE it saw, and merges --no-ff for real.
answers.traces_to: Law 4 and Law 7: the artifact door is physics only if every path into a record repo passes it, and a land is a path into the commons.
answers.what: A git merge into the commons (any repo whose hook is the artifact tool's) runs the same blocking artifact check as a commit there.

bullets.text: Every commons land skips the artifact check, the same hole A1 closes for cairn; 6 of the last 40 commons commits are merges.
